parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The object key to sort the results by.

parameters.name: iterations_of
parameters.description: The `id` of the experiment that you want to get the iterations of.

parameters.name: owners
parameters.description: An array of `user` ids to sort results by.

parameters.name: teams
parameters.description: Array of `team` ids to sort results by.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: An array of `tag` ids to sort results by.

parameters.name: applications
parameters.description: An array of `application` ids to sort results by.

parameters.name: unit_types
parameters.description: An array of `unit_type` ids to sort results by.

parameters.name: previews
parameters.description: A boolean value which deliminates whether you want all experiment data or just a few specific statistics

parameters.name: impact
parameters.description: A tuple value which allows you to specify a `from` and a `to` range of impacts to filter by. **This must be used with a preview query of `1`**

parameters.name: confidence
parameters.description: A tuple value which allows you to specify a `from` and a `to` range of confidences to filter by. **This must be used with a preview query of `1`**

parameters.name: significance
parameters.description: An array of significances allowing you to filter by positive, negative or unsignificant experiments. **This must be used with a preview query of `1`**

parameters.name: sample_ratio_mismatch
parameters.description: A boolean value which allows you to filter for experiments with a `Sample Ratio Mismatch` alert. **This must be used with a preview query of `1`**

parameters.name: cleanup_needed
parameters.description: A boolean value which allows you to filter for experiments with a `Code Cleanup Needed` alert. **This must be used with a preview query of `1`**

parameters.name: audience_mismatch
parameters.description: A boolean value which allows you to filter for experiments with a `Target Audience Mismatch` alert. **This must be used with a preview query of `1`**

parameters.name: sample_size_reached
parameters.description: A boolean value which allows you to filter for experiments with a `Sample Size Reached` alert. **This must be used with a preview query of `1`**

parameters.name: sort_asc
parameters.description: A boolean value which allows you to reverse the order of the experiment list

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: An integer value which allows you to limit the number of experiments that are returned per page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: An integer value which represents what page of the experiments list to return
